        vals=[grid[a][b] if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w else 0 for a,b in pts]
        # TL receives BL; TR receives TL; BL receives BR; BR receives TR.

                    out[rr][cc]=color
                rr+=dr;cc+=dc
